summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on providing demographic data and specific metrics for a VIOOH report requested by someone (via Esben). The required data needs to be pulled from the `data-api` using demographics. 

Technical discussions followed regarding necessary infrastructure upgrades, specifically migrating aggregates and trusted sessions (used by analytics and data-api) to 2 shards + 2 replicas to enable zero-downtime updates. This upgrade was proposed for the weekend but alternative times were suggested.

Regarding the report content, it was confirmed that a previous job existed (`upload_day_afa-hourly5mins-dwell.sh`) which provided dwell time data with hourly/5-minute granularity, addressing questions about session duration and data granularity.
decisions: The team will investigate providing demographic data via the data-api for the VIOOH report.
A meeting was tentatively scheduled for 8 AM tomorrow (date not specified).
It was confirmed that a previous job provided dwell time with hourly/5-minute granularity.
